summary: This version of the library builds its list of genres in a Set instead of a List, so each genre appears only once no matter how many books share it. The program then prints the de-duplicated genre list.

lines.text: Three of the five books carry the genre "Fantasy", which is exactly the duplication that cluttered the earlier printout.
This one declaration is the whole change: a Set only holds unique items, and HashSet is the everyday Set the way ArrayList is the everyday List.
Every book's genre is added without any duplicate check, because adding a value the Set already holds is not an error  or}, {
